mentions.name: Enlace
mentions.description: An open source, self-hosted file sharing platform with a Go backend and a Svelte frontend. It was created in response to two existing self-hosted file sharing projects archiving their repositories, is nearly complete, and is looking for help with testing.
mentions.problem: Two self-hosted open source file sharing platforms archived their repos, indicating no further updates.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wanted an opportunity to learn more Svelte so I created Enlace which has a Go backend and Svelte frontend.

It's nearly complete but I would love any assistance with testing.
